_readme: Benchmark trips for grading the router. Each trip says where, when, and
what a person who knows the GTA would actually do (expected_plain).
expected_combo   - which of the three searches should contain the sane
null means 'no confident expectation yet, just report'.
must_include_any - at least ONE of these place/route names must appear
in the suggested itinerary for it to count as sane.
max_minutes      - slower than this is a miss even if the shape is right.
known_unfair     - true = expected to fail for a known data reason;
day: 'weekday' resolves to next Tuesday, 'saturday' to next Saturday.

trips.description: Markham (Unionville area) to Union Station, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: Drive (or bike) to Unionville or Centennial GO, Stouffville line train to Union.

trips.description: Markham (Unionville area) to Square One, Mississauga, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: UNCERTAIN - suburb to suburb. The GO 56 bus along the 407 lands about 500m from Square One, so transit-only ~90 min may genuinely be the answer. MiWay is loaded now.

trips.description: Scarborough (Guildwood area) to King & Bay downtown, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: GO Lakeshore East train from Guildwood GO, or TTC bus to Line 2 at Kennedy.

trips.description: Richmond Hill (Yonge & Major Mackenzie) to North York Centre, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: YRT/Viva down Yonge to Finch, then subway Line 1 two stops to North York Centre.

trips.description: CONTROL: The Annex (Bathurst & Bloor) to Yonge & Dundas, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: Short downtown trip where plain transit IS the right answer: Line 2 from Bathurst to Yonge, or the 511/streetcar. Driving to a station would be silly here.

trips.description: Pickering (residential, north of the 401) to Union Station, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: Drive to Pickering GO, Lakeshore East train to Union. DRT local buses are loaded now, so transit-only should use a DRT bus to reach the station.

trips.description: Vaughan (Maple, near Keele & Major Mackenzie) to Union Station, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: Walk or drive to Maple GO, Barrie line train to Union. Driving to Line 1 at Vaughan Metropolitan Centre is a plausible alternative.

trips.description: Downtown (near Union) to Pearson Airport Terminal 1, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: UP Express from Union to Pearson, about 25 minutes. Tests that the UP feed is used.

trips.description: Etobicoke (Long Branch) to Union Station, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: GO Lakeshore West train from Long Branch GO (fast), or the 501 streetcar (slow but cheap). GO should be the headline answer at 8am.

trips.description: Richmond Hill (Yonge & Major Mackenzie) to Scarborough Town Centre, weekday 8am
trips.expected_plain: UNCERTAIN - awkward suburb-to-suburb trip with no obvious answer. Included to see what the router says.
